audience: newsletter writers and publishers who collect votes and feedback with FeedLetter

useCases.title: Find a survey and read its votes
useCases.text: Search your surveys by name, id or external id. Then read one survey with its analytics, votes and feedback.

useCases.title: Build a Wall of Love into your website
useCases.text: Read the feedback items that one Wall of Love shows, with their answers and dates. Use them to build the wall on your own site.

useCases.title: Create a newsletter survey for an issue
useCases.text: Create a newsletter survey with an external id, so a repeat call returns the same survey. Use the voting links or email HTML it returns.

useCases.title: Create a web rating widget and get its embed code
useCases.text: Create a web rating widget. Copy the embed HTML it returns to place the widget on your website.
